sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: *Hol*? asks where someone or something is. The location phrase normally comes before van in a simple location sentence.

items.english: The book is on the table.

sections.content: Here van is doing real work — confirming existence and location — which is exactly the job it refuses to do when you’re simply saying what something IS (no van needed there, as you may already have noticed). Keep the two situations mentally separate: location and existence keep van, plain identity drops it.
